assertions.name: hoefsmit_chi_finite_per_block_for_n3
assertions.source: Stage A operational gate: the Hoefsmit seminormal rep infra (hecke_characters.chi_lambda_braid) produces finite per-block Markov-trace components χ^λ(identity), χ^λ(Hopf), χ^λ(electron-trefoil) for all 3 partitions of n=3, at q_0. Necessary precondition for Stage B (operator-level N=k extraction).

description: Stage A of the 1ppQ keystone (Hoefsmit operator construction): compute the per-Wedderburn-block Markov-trace components Tr ρ_λ(electron word) = χ^λ(σ₀σ₁σ₀) for λ ⊢ 3 (proton H_3 blocks); validate the operator-matrix infra by recombining via Wenzl weights against the canonical scalar Δ(net). Foundation for N=k operator-level extraction.

data.stage_a_status: computed only — per-block χ at q_0 (canonical Δ(net) absent/null in upstream witness; recombination check deferred to when canonical values are populated)
data.stage_b_next: build per-block operator T_β,λ via Hoefsmit + confinement SDP; read N=k correction levels off the matrix expansion in b(q)·ℏ_q² scaling; extract c_4..c_8 as the N=k operator-trace components.
